jobs.occupation: Master Thesis in Aerodynamics in the  Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department (d/f/m) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Aerodynamics in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a job title? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Gust Loads & Aeroelastics department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.06.2025
- Duration: 6 months

Your opportunity

- Are you passionate about aircraft physics?
- Are you keen to master the way we compute external loads acting on the vehicle due to maneuvers, flight in turbulence, landing impact, ground-handling?
- Do you like to work in an empowered manner?
- Do you enjoy connecting people and collaborating with many different interfaces?
- This job will give you the opportunity to work internationally with several internal flight physics departments and with teams located in Europe and India.

About us

We are a team of 16 multicultural and passionate engineers who perform the gust calculations for overall aircraft design for all aircraft types. Our team is involved from a very early design stage until certification and also in-service support. We are responsible for running build model activities such as finite element modeling, creating mass and aerodynamics models. We perform gust loads calculation, including failure cases, and deliver to internal interfaces. On top, we are deeply involved in research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, model based system engineering, automation and machine learning.

Introduction

The current industry approaches of modeling unsteady aerodynamic flow for the prediction of gust loads typically assume linear flow conditions. Linearity greatly reduces the computational time required to evaluate all the flight points and gust conditions required by the certification specifications (CS-25). At the same time, disregarding non-linearities such as boundary layer separation arising from the high angles of attack induced by strong gusts can lead to an over-estimation of loads and thus to an increased structural weight of the aircraft.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

During this six months Master thesis you will develop and evaluate an unsteady aerodynamic model that includes the effect of flow separation in a piecewise linear approach. The model will be built using linearized computational fluid dynamics (CFD) of a complete flexible aircraft and adapted using aerodynamic data obtained in the non-linear flow region at high angles of attack. You will evaluate the model by comparison against higher-fidelity models, such as obtained from non-linear time domain simulation, with respect to gust loads.

You will contribute to:

- Optimize the design of Airbus commercial aircraft in the frame of new wing technologies
- the development of new approaches to model unsteady aerodynamics considering non-linearities for gust loads and flutter computation
- Actively support us as a new member of our team on our journey

Desired skills and qualifications

- You are a fulltime enrolled master student (d/f/m) within Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
- You have good knowledge in aerodynamics, CFD and potential flows
- Ideally you already have first experience in CFD using TAU or CODA
- You have knowledge in coding using Python and/or Matlab
- You bring basic knowledge in overall aircraft design and basic competencies in flight loads calculation and flight mechanics
- You are passionate to understand physical aspects and to use your engineering judgement
- If you are familiar with tools like MSC.NASTRAN or ALTAIR HyperWorks, this is beneficial
- You are a highly motivated, proactive and open-minded person with a great sense of initiative
- You are keen to deepen your technical knowledge while enjoying to work in a multicultural team
- Your English is at negotiating level

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided.
